<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="pool" name="Equipment change" processRef="proc" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="proc" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="mpon" name="MPON">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyIntent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reading</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>dismount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>readCount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>tellGo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="mpoo" name="MPOO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>announce</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyNo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="go" name="GO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyMsp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Equipment change intended" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyIntent" name="Notify the MPOO about equipment change intentions" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="decide" name="Self dismounting by MPOO?" />
    <bpmn:task id="announce" name="Announce self dismounting to the MPON" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyNo" name="Notify the MPON about no self-dismounting" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="reading" name="Perform the final reading" />
    <bpmn:task id="dismount" name="Dismount the old equipment" />
    <bpmn:task id="mount" name="Mount the new device" />
    <bpmn:task id="readCount" name="Read the meter count from the installed meter" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendValues" name="Send the values of the final reading to the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="tellGo" name="Tell the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyMsp" name="Notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting and the meter count at installation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="MSP notified" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="notifyIntent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="notifyIntent" targetRef="decide" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="decide" targetRef="announce" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="decide" targetRef="notifyNo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="announce" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="notifyNo" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="reading" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="reading" targetRef="dismount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="dismount" targetRef="mount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="mount" targetRef="readCount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="readCount" targetRef="sendValues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="sendValues" targetRef="tellGo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="tellGo" targetRef="notifyMsp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="notifyMsp" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
